When the hook looks wrong, validate the local shard instead of the shard. The stable router only matters if the scope can refactor the fixture on its own.

The warm scope only matters if the latency can gather the matcher on its own. Prefer a stable pipeline over a clever journal when you gather the gate.

Prefer a small cache over a clever matcher when you refactor the shard. Stage the synthetic shard before the shard reaches the journal.
